scope: Official source discovery only. Methods limited to robots GET, small public index GET and document HEAD when the robots check permitted it. No credentials, form submissions, PDF bodies, or acquisitions.
policy: An explicit origin 404 for robots.txt is treated as the absent policy response used in the Guwahati AFT rollout. A 403, 5xx, transport failure or ambiguous non-robots HTML response holds subsequent automated access. HTTP observations identify only the response received by the runner and do not establish reuse rights or document identity.
